landing.heroTag: AI essay coach for ambitious students
landing.heroTitle: Write Better Essays. Unlock Bigger Opportunities.
landing.heroSubtitle: Sharpen your academic writing, expand vocabulary, and level up your skills through AI coaching and interactive educational games.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Six steps from draft to opportunity
landing.step1Desc: Sign up in sixty seconds and get 50 Pink Coins right away on the house.
landing.step2Desc: Drafts save automatically to your Essay Lab, so nothing is ever lost.
landing.step3Desc: See your score, the exact sentences to fix, and why each fix makes your argument stronger.
landing.step4Desc: Apply corrections one by one — your personal voice and thoughts remain yours.
landing.step5Title: Play games and earn Pink Coins
landing.step5Desc: Analyses and vocabulary mini-games reward your honest educational effort.
landing.step6Desc: Grow from Simple Sheep to Legendary Sheep to unlock advanced rubrics and perks.
landing.featuresTitle: A dedicated writing studio, not another generic chat window
landing.featuresSubtitle: PinkSheep.hub combines an AI essay examiner with daily practice designed for students applying to life-changing programs.
landing.feat1Desc: A comprehensive 100-point rubric evaluating grammar, academic vocabulary, coherence, task response, and structure.
landing.feat2Desc: Step-by-step actionable recommendations generated specifically for your writing gaps after every review.
landing.feat3Desc: Word Wolf, Sentence Builder, and Essay Logic turn academic writing practice into an engaging 2-minute daily habit.
landing.feat4Desc: Swap weak casual words with rigorous academic verbs and phrases through interactive challenges.
landing.feat5Desc: Earn coins for real learning milestones — all securely stored in your personal account balance.
landing.feat6Desc: Advance from Simple Sheep to Legendary Sheep and see where you stand among top student writers worldwide.
landing.levelsSubtitle: Levels unlock automatically as you write, practise, and win games. They can never be bought.
landing.ctaTitle: Your next great opportunity starts with a better essay.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join young scholars who treat academic writing as a craft — practiced, measured, and rewarded.
